title: Free Cash
statementMd:
Valera runs a 24/7 fast food cafe. He magically learned that next day $*n*$ people will visit his cafe. For each person we know the arrival time: the $*i*$-th person comes exactly at $*h*_{*i*}$ hours $*m*_{*i*}$ minutes. The cafe spends less than a minute to serve each client, but if a client comes in and sees that there is no free cash, than he doesn't want to wait and leaves the cafe immediately.

Valera is very greedy, so he wants to serve all $*n*$ customers next day (and get more profit). However, for that he needs to ensure that at each moment of time the number of working cashes is no less than the number of clients in the cafe.

Help Valera count the minimum number of cashes to work at his cafe next day, so that they can serve all visitors.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$, that is the number of cafe visitors.

Each of the following $*n*$ lines has two space-separated integers $*h*_{*i*}$ and $*m*_{*i*}$ $(0 ≤ *h*_{*i*} ≤ 23; 0 ≤ *m*_{*i*} ≤ 59)$, representing the time when the $*i*$-th person comes into the cafe.

Note that the time is given in the **chronological** order. All time is given within one 24-hour period.

## Output

Print a single integer — the minimum number of cashes, needed to serve all clients next day.

## Note

In the first sample it is not enough one cash to serve all clients, because two visitors will come into cafe in 8:10. Therefore, if there will be one cash in cafe, then one customer will be served by it, and another one will not wait and will go away.

In the second sample all visitors will come in different times, so it will be enough one cash.
statementZhMd:
瓦列拉经营着一家全天候营业的快餐店。他神奇地得知，第二天将有 $*n*$ 个人来他的餐厅。对于每个人，我们都知道其到达时间：第 $*i*$ 个人将在 $*h*_{*i*}$ 时 $*m*_{*i*}$ 分准时到达。餐厅为每位顾客提供服务所需的时间不到一分钟，但如果顾客到店后发现没有空闲的收银台，他不想等待，会立即离开餐厅。

瓦列拉非常贪心，因此他希望第二天为全部 $*n*$ 位顾客提供服务（从而获得更多利润）。然而，为此他需要确保在每个时刻，正在工作的收银台数量不少于餐厅内顾客的数量。

请帮助瓦列拉计算第二天餐厅至少需要启用多少个收银台，才能为所有到访者提供服务。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$，表示餐厅的到访者数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*h*_{*i*}$ 和 $*m*_{*i*}$ $(0 ≤ *h*_{*i*} ≤ 23; 0 ≤ *m*_{*i*} ≤ 59)$，表示第 $*i*$ 个人到达餐厅的时间。

注意，时间按照**时间顺序**给出。所有时间均在同一个 24 小时周期内。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——第二天为所有顾客提供服务所需的最少收银台数量。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，一个收银台不足以为所有顾客提供服务，因为有两位顾客将在 8:10 到达。因此，如果餐厅只有一个收银台，其中一位顾客会得到服务，而另一位顾客不愿等待就会离开。

在第二个样例中，所有顾客都在不同的时间到达，因此一个收银台就足够了。
